QuestInfo.name: What Moren Dropped
QuestInfo.0: It's been a while since I started producing items. I think I am now at the point where Moren is starting to acknowledge my item-producing skills. He seems to be devoting all of his time to creating a new item. I better stop by and say hello...
QuestInfo.1: Moren had been devoting all of his time to creating a new item. When I visited him at Magatia, he seemed so into his work that he didn't even realize I was there, and kept on mumbling illegible things. That's when I noticed something dropped behind his back. What is that?
QuestInfo.2: I visited Moren at a lab in Magatia, but he seemed very much into his work that he didn't notice me walking in. That's when I noticed a piece of paper dropped from behind his back. The note contained a whole bunch of notes. What does it say?
